title: Are You Accidentally Being Rude? 🤯 English Restaurant Hacks #Shorts

subtitles.en:
Alex, when you travel abroad, what is the
first thing you say at a restaurant?
subtitles.zh: Alex，當你出國旅行時，你在餐廳開口說的第一句話是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Definitely not: I want this, or give me the
bill!
subtitles.zh: 絕對不是說「我要這個」或「給我帳單」！

subtitles.en:
Wait, really? I say that all the time! Is
that rude?
subtitles.zh: 等等，真的嗎？我每次都這樣說耶！這樣很沒禮貌嗎？

subtitles.en:
It is not rude on purpose, but to native
speakers, it sounds like a bossy command!
subtitles.zh: 不是故意的，但在母語人士耳裡，這聽起來像強硬的命令句！

subtitles.en:
Oh no! Then how should I politely order my
food?
subtitles.zh: 天啊！那我該怎麼有禮貌地點餐呢？

subtitles.en:
Instead of I want, say: Could I get the
steak, please?
subtitles.zh:
不要說 我要，改說：「請問我可以點 the steak,
please?」

subtitles.en:
Could I get the steak, please. That sounds so
natural and polite!
subtitles.zh:
請問我可以點 the steak, please.
這樣聽起來自然又有禮貌多了！

subtitles.en:
Exactly! Or you can simply say: I would like
the steak, please.
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！或者你也可以說：「I would like the steak,
please.」

subtitles.en:
Got it! And what if I don't want cilantro or
onions?
subtitles.zh: 記住了！那如果我不要香菜或洋蔥呢？

subtitles.en:
Don't say no cilantro! Just say: Could I get
this without cilantro, please?
subtitles.zh:
別直說 no cilantro！只要說：「請問我可以點 this wi
thout cilantro, please?」

subtitles.en:
Without cilantro! And what if I want the
sauce on the side?
subtitles.zh: Without cilantro！那如果我希望醬料另外放呢？

subtitles.en:
Super simple: Could I have the dressing on
the side?
subtitles.zh:
超簡單：「Could I have the dressing on t
he side?」

subtitles.en:
On the side. That is so helpful! What if the
food is taking forever?
subtitles.zh: On the side. 太實用了！那如果等了很久餐點都沒來呢？

subtitles.en:
Never say: Where is my food! That sounds like
starting a fight!
subtitles.zh: 千萬別說 我的餐點在哪裡？！！那聽起來像要找人吵架！

subtitles.en: Oops! What is the polite way to ask?
subtitles.zh: 哎呀！那該怎麼禮貌詢問呢？

subtitles.en:
Politely say: Excuse me, could you check on
our order, please?
subtitles.zh:
禮貌地說：「Excuse me, could you 確認餐點進度,
please?」

subtitles.en:
Could you check on our order. So calm and
elegant!
subtitles.zh: Could you 確認餐點進度. 既得體又有效率！

subtitles.en:
Finally, time to pay! Can I say: Give me the
bill?
subtitles.zh: 最後要結帳了！可以說 把帳單給我 嗎？

subtitles.en:
No! Instead, say: Could we get the check,
please?
subtitles.zh: 不行！請改說：「可以幫我們買單嗎, please?」

subtitles.en:
And if we want to pay separately: Can we
split the bill?
subtitles.zh: 如果要分開付就是：「我們可以分開結帳嗎」對吧？

subtitles.en:
Perfect! What phrase do you use most often?
Share with us below!
subtitles.zh: 完全正確！大家出國最常講哪一句？歡迎在留言區跟我們分享！

subtitles.en:
Subscribe for more practical English tips,
and see you next time!
subtitles.zh: 記得訂閱學習更多道地實用英語，我們下次見！
